*.env.reason: Denied: .env files may hold credentials. If you only need key names, use rg -o '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=' and never read the values

*.env.*.reason: Denied: .env.* files may hold credentials. If you only need key names, use rg -o '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=' and never read the values

~/.ssh/*.reason: Denied: private keys and config under ~/.ssh

~/.pi/agent/auth.json.reason: Denied: pi credential file (contains API keys)

~/.pi/agent/models.json.reason: Denied: pi model config (may contain endpoints and credentials)

~/.pi/agent/models-store.json.reason: Denied: pi model cache (may contain endpoints and credentials)

*$*.reason: Denied: path contains an unresolved shell variable ($DIR and friends). An unset variable expands to / or /* (rm -rf $DIR/ becomes rm -rf /). $HOME and $PWD are resolved by the extension and unaffected. Run echo to confirm the value first, then rewrite the command with a literal path

grep *.reason: Denied by policy: bash grep is blocked. Use ffgrep/fffind to locate things; for exhaustive or audit scans that need deterministic full output use rg -uu --sort path (-uu disables ignore and hidden-file skipping, --sort path makes order reproducible) or a python3 script

find *.reason: Denied by policy: bash find is blocked. Use fffind or fd to find files; for full enumeration use fd -H -I -u or rg -uu --files --sort path

truncate *$*.reason: Denied: truncate target must not use a shell variable. An unset variable degrades the target to the root directory. Run echo to confirm the value first, then rewrite with a literal path

shred *$*.reason: Denied: shred target must not use a shell variable. An unset variable degrades the target to the root directory. Run echo to confirm the value first, then rewrite with a literal path

dd *$*.reason: Denied: dd arguments must not use a shell variable. An unset variable makes of= point at the root directory. Run echo to confirm the value first, then rewrite with a literal path

git clean*$*.reason: Denied: git clean arguments must not use a shell variable. An unset variable silently widens the cleanup scope. Run echo to confirm the value first, then rewrite with a literal path
